direction: MERGE_WITH_B_AS_BASE (conditional on the scorecard conditions C1..C5)
merge_definition_enforced: one canonical repository, one app, one package strategy, one signing strategy, one release line, no duplicated implementations

phases.name: keystore_repair_landing
phases.content: the Tower account integrates the A2 drop-in package (TowerStore.kt + PairingPersistence.kt + tests + PairingFlow delta), rebuilds with the SAME debug keystore, registers the new SHA-256, hands the APK to the Owner
phases.rollback: reinstall the previous B APK; the failed build stays in the ledger

phases.name: authority_core_port
phases.content: port B's authority lane into the canonical repository behind a typed TowerRuntimeIntegration seam: PairingFlow(+repaired TowerStore), DeviceKeys(EC-P256), QrPayload v2 parser, TowerApi (18 endpoints), ConsoleTurnController/Service, TtsPlayer, VoiceCaptureEngine, ArchiveRepository+SafeIntents, NsdDiscovery, ArtifactDownloadWorker, ZXing decode adapter
phases.constraint: mock executors move to test/simulator scopes ONLY - production paths use the real authority (no parallel authority, section 2)
phases.rollback: seam keeps the mock executor selectable in MOCK_SIMULATOR mode; revert commit removes the port cleanly

phases.name: qr_v2_adapter
phases.content: versioned QR v2 parser beside the existing strict v1 parser (RD-04): accepts the live Tower schema, rejects secret-bearing payloads, maps rejections to the six mission typed states
phases.constraint: v1 parser stays for legacy test fixtures; v2 is the production scanner default

phases.name: product_maturity_absorption
phases.content: B's UX screens adopt A's theme system, 5-language layer, accessibility, responsive shell, diagnostics; A's offline STT/model-manager lanes stay OPTIONAL under the Resource Envelope (A7), Tower-first default

phases.name: unification
phases.content: ONE applicationId, ONE release signing authority (Owner-held keystore, secure backup, fingerprint registered), ONE version line continuing code 12+ lineage, SBOM/NOTICE regenerated
phases.owner_gate: C5 - package ID change + signing authority + supersede of installed apps: EXPLICIT Owner approvals, one per item
phases.rollback: both previous APKs remain installable until Owner accepts the unified build

phases.name: dedup_and_retirement
phases.content: delete duplicated implementations (A's candidate Tower contract files retire to simulator scopes; B's repo keeps history but stops producing new APKs); Rule Theta final pass; license registries reconciled
phases.owner_gate: retirement of either codebase = explicit Owner decision
phases.rollback: git history preserves everything; no force operations

invariants_during_merge: Tower stays the ONLY authority (no client-side bypass at any phase)
every phase ships as a testable build; no phase deletes evidence
every phase records a typed receipt + semantic diff + fresh read-back (Rule Theta)
no secrets, no private keys, ever
verdict: A4R_MERGE_PLAN_PRODUCED - 6 phases, owner-gated, rollback per phase
